claims.text: Machine learning models can exhibit systematic discriminatory behavior based on demographic attributes due to imbalanced training data and the complexity of underlying algorithms.
An LLM-assisted automated discriminatory test generation approach can be developed using GPT-4o Mini and Claude Sonnet 4 to identify discriminatory behavior in machine learning model outcomes.

evidence.description: Machine learning (ML) models can exhibit systematic discriminatory behavior based on demographic attributes (e.g., race and gender) due to imbalanced training data and the complexity of underlying algorithms.
We developed an LLM-assisted automated discriminatory test generation approach for identifying discriminatory behavior in ML model outcomes using GPT-4o Mini and Claude Sonnet 4 model.

methodologies.name: LLM-assisted automated discriminatory test generation
methodologies.description: An automated test generation approach utilizing natural language prompts with GPT-4o Mini and Claude Sonnet 4 models to identify discriminatory behavior in ML model outcomes.
